outcome.technical: The three sentences the finding quotes no longer exist at base 071637de. Commit 9eeea6d5 (P142.14) had already replaced them in CLAUDE.md (about line 239), CONTRIBUTING.md (about line 331) and ci.yml (about line 134) with the block model (a staged suite whose STAGES is a literal runs one job per block, one slot each, then a replay) plus a pointer to the `blocks, not suites` comment above work_items(), which holds the one statement of the fallback. A grep over the three files for admitted|stage_grant|STAGE_GRANT|all but one found no stale admission wording. The admission rule the finding drafted (up to stage_grant(jobs), what is free, at least one) now applies only to the fallback path, a staged suite whose table cannot be read as a literal (sweep() admitted(), tools/sweep-selftests.py about lines 1825-1838). The documents defer that path to the comment, so I did not restate it, because restating it would make a second copy. The one remaining claim in these files about what a staged suite holds was CONTRIBUTING.md's `budget:` sentence, 'which suites held several slots'. budget_line() (tools/sweep-selftests.py:2138-2161) is written before sweep() runs (:2286) and prints 'N staged suites hold up to G each', and under slot_gate a suite run whole can hold one slot. I reworded that sentence: the line is written before the first job starts; it names which staged suites will run whole and the most slots each may hold (stage_grant(jobs)); each takes what is free when its turn comes, at least one (slot_gate wait :1452-1458), is told the number in SWEEP_STAGE_GRANT (run_one :1145), and has its timeout calibrated to it (admitted: file_timeout(..., held, ...)). I made no change to CLAUDE.md or ci.yml. Diff: CONTRIBUTING.md, 5 lines added and 2 removed. Run: python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py tests/test__deps.py tests/test__output_lints.py -> exit 0, 2/2 files ok, 427 cases. Dependants: CONTRIBUTING.md's tests/test__deps.py and tests/test__output_lints.py are still correct (green above). The other CONTRIBUTING.md dependants listed (.claude/skills/before-you-claim/evals/evals.json, plugins/audit/scripts/_output.py, tests/test__areas.py, tests/test_derive_phase_gate.py, tools/affected.py, tools/check-committed-pii.py) refer to the file by name, not to this paragraph. A grep of the tree for 'held several slots|which suites held' returns nothing (exit 1), so none of them quotes the replaced wording, and they are still correct. CLAUDE.md and ci.yml dependants: those files are unchanged, so their dependants are unaffected. Left for P142.27: the three documents already state the block model at base, so the doc half of its rewrite may already be done. The fallback paragraph of the `blocks, not suites` comment (tools/sweep-selftests.py about line 1661, not a file of mine) says a whole-run suite is told its number in STAGE_GRANT_VAR but not that its timeout is calibrated to that number. The code does this (admitted passes `held` to file_timeout). The comment, which the documents defer to, is the place to add it.
outcome.descriptive: No document still states the old staged-suite admission rule. CONTRIBUTING.md's budget-line sentence now says a whole-run staged suite may hold up to stage_grant(jobs) slots, takes what is free (at least one), and is told that number and timed by it.
